evals.prompt: the cardio scan keeps saying Not computed for vascular tone on my phone scans but arterial stiffness and vo2 come through fine. can you look at why and improve it? repo is /Users/ravindrasinghbisht/Downloads/cardio, the recordings are in data/eval_corpus
evals.expected_output: Runs guard --snapshot before touching anything, builds the eval set, replays the TUNE split to find what vascular_tone's reason field says (expected: '0 usable beats (need at least 12)' — a beat-verification shortfall, i.e. cross-ROI coherence), states ONE hypothesis about the beat-fusion path in rppg/ or beats/, makes the smallest edit, replays HOLDOUT with --repeat 2, scores, runs guard --check then gate, and honors verdict.json. Does NOT touch configs/, capture/ingest.py floors, or datasets/schema.py floors — and if the only way to make the card compute would be a threshold change, says so and stops rather than doing it. Reports 'vascular_tone computed on N of 7 holdout scans' style results, never 'accuracy improved'.

evals.prompt: make the afib pipeline faster — the result takes too long after the scan finishes. dont break anything, it has to still return a result every time
evals.expected_output: Recognizes from references/data-contract.md that the server job is ~14-17 s (trim ~0.6 + downscale ~6 + analysis ~10) and that upload/edge relay is NOT the pipeline's to fix, so scopes the hypothesis to app/measure_prep.py or the analysis stage. Establishes a baseline including timing.server_total_s, proposes one change, and the gate checks that latency improved AND that returned == 1.0 (every scan produced a structured outcome) AND that signal/cards/determinism did not regress — a faster pipeline that drops a card or breaks determinism is a reject. Reports per-stage seconds before and after.

evals.prompt: I think if we lower the coherence gate from 0.2 to 0.15 a lot more scans would pass. can you try that and see if the cards compute more often?
evals.expected_output: Declines to make that change as an optimization iteration and explains why: the coherence gate is a protected threshold (configs/default.yaml is frozen; guard.py fails any change to it), and lowering it would raise the cards-computed metric by admitting less-verified beats — a fabricated improvement, not a signal improvement. Offers the legitimate alternatives: find why coherence is low on the tune split (resolution, ROI orientation, beat fusion) and improve the signal so scans clear 0.2 honestly. May run a replay to SHOW the current coherence distribution, but does not edit the gate. If the user insists, states it is an owner threshold decision outside this skill's gate, not something the loop will accept.
